uuids.note: Rig decision change 3 / cm.md §14: the part table is fixed and append-only; proxies take 0x41 + their position in proxies.layout

proxies.note: ground columns [x, z, top] in the local frame (x = the boss left, z = forward, top above the floor incl. the margin, 0 = parked); rest = the contract §6.1 numbers (pinned), rest_pose = the R3a idle columns; per clip in clips[].px

clips.name: idle
clips.note: breathing (chest +-1.2, root +-0.05, 80 t), head drift (pitch +-2.5 / 40 t, yaw +-3 / 80 t), the snarl (jaw 3 -> 8 -> 3 over 30-50), the tail wave (+-4, 3 t lag per segment), feet planted

clips.name: walk
clips.note: lateral-sequence walk for the module glide of 0.13 b/t (stride 5.2 b): plants LH 0, LF 10, RH 20, RF 30, fore lift 0.6, hind 0.45; root -0.12 with a dip after each fore plant, chest roll +-1.5, spine yaw +-2.5 against the chest, a head counter-bob, the tail swinging +-5

clips.name: walk_stop
clips.note: from the walk: the right fore plants at 4 (the last stride), the left fore and both hinds square up 5-14, the body pitches forward 2 and settles, the head bobs once, the tail swings through

clips.name: turn45_l
clips.note: a 45 degree turn to its left in two diagonal steps (the outer fore + the inner hind at 10, then the other pair at 17), the head leading 14 degrees, the pelvis 3 t behind, the tail dragging out and swinging through

clips.name: turn45_r
clips.note: mirror of turn45_l: a 45 degree turn to its left in two diagonal steps (the outer fore + the inner hind at 10, then the other pair at 17), the head leading 14 degrees, the pelvis 3 t behind, the tail dragging out and swinging through

clips.name: turn90_l
clips.note: a 90 degree turn to its left in four diagonal steps (12, 18, 24, 30), the head leading 22 degrees

clips.name: turn90_r
clips.note: mirror of turn90_l: a 90 degree turn to its left in four diagonal steps (12, 18, 24, 30), the head leading 22 degrees

clips.name: turn180
clips.note: a 180 degree turn to its left in eight diagonal steps (12 ... 54, each foot four times), the head leading 40 degrees (the module mirrors the sign for the other way)

clips.name: intro
clips.note: sealed crouch, still (0-30); a dip, then the rear-up (pelvis +48, 32-56) with the fores folded at chest height; the rear-up roar held with a tremor (58-100); the drop to all fours, fores landing at 116; the low roar (jaw 50, head thrust up) 120-136; settle into idle by 150

clips.name: pose_ref
clips.note: the portrait: a low roaring crouch, the fores braced wide, the head thrust up, jaw 45, the tail high

clips.name: roar_low
clips.note: the body pushes back onto the haunches (root -0.25, pelvis +6), the fores step out wide, the head thrusts up 20; roar at 10 (jaw 50), the blast at 12, a held tremor to 36, close and settle

clips.name: roar_rear
clips.note: load (root -0.3, head down, tail pressed), the rise 8-20 (pelvis +55, the fores leave the floor at 12 and fold up and out at chest height, head thrown back, jaw 46), roar at 20, the hold with a 4-t tremor and the tail braced, the drop 76-89, fores land at 90, compression, a head shake

clips.name: chin_slam
clips.note: anticipation 0-14 (head up and to its left, jaw 18, weight back), the rear-up 14-22 (pelvis +48, the left fore highest), the hold 22-41 looking down with a sway, the slam 41-47 (ease in: the chin into the floor, the neck stretched), impact at 47, compression to 50, the head kept low to 70 (played 55), recovered by 84

clips.name: jump_slam
clips.note: deep crouch 0-6 (root -0.55), the front lifts and the hinds push at 8 (take-off), the body pitched up +16 rising, level at the apex, nose down falling with the fores reaching; the fores and chest land at 28 (wave 1, compression), the rear comes down with a heave, the hinds land at 39 (wave 2); settle, the head up last

clips.name: charge_coil
clips.note: the head lowers (0-8), the lateral C-curl to its right flank 8-14 (spine / chest / neck yaw, the right shoulder dropped, root -0.4, the tail swung round), a trembling hold to 31 (the tell), the release 31-34 (launch at 32: the body straightens low, the fores reach)

clips.name: charge_run
clips.note: a low bound gallop (12 t) under the module glide of 1.0 b/t: hinds push 0-3, fores land at 6 / 7 and stand 3 t, body pitch +-5, root +-0.22 about -0.3, head low with the horns forward and still turned 5 degrees to the curl side, the tail streaming low

clips.name: charge_stop
clips.note: the skid 0-8 (fores braced forward, the rear swung out by pelvis yaw +22, root -0.4), stop at 8, the recovery 8-24 (the feet square up one by one, the head lifts, the tail swings through)

clips.name: spikes
clips.note: brace 0-14 (crouch root -0.35, back humped, the plates bristling +12 with a shiver), the heave 15-18 (flare +22, scale 1.1, jaw open), the launch at 18, the secondary burst at 24, relax 24-34, settle by 48

clips.name: stomp_fl
clips.note: weight shift to the right 0-6, the left fore lifts 6-15 to the hang (wrist 2.95 b, elbow high, the front rolled away, head turned to the foot), hang 15-17, the slam 17-22 = wave 1, compression and a shiver, two shoulder pushes for waves 2 / 3 at 37 / 52, recover

clips.name: stomp_fr
clips.note: mirror of stomp_fl: weight shift to the right 0-6, the left fore lifts 6-15 to the hang (wrist 2.95 b, elbow high, the front rolled away, head turned to the foot), hang 15-17, the slam 17-22 = wave 1, compression and a shiver, two shoulder pushes for waves 2 / 3 at 37 / 52, recover

clips.name: stomp_hl
clips.note: the hind variant: the pelvis rolls away, the left hock lifts knee-high (2.65 b) with the foot curled, the tail swings to the other side as a counterweight; the slam at 22, two haunch pushes for waves 2 / 3

clips.name: stomp_hr
clips.note: mirror of stomp_hl: the hind variant: the pelvis rolls away, the left hock lifts knee-high (2.65 b) with the foot curled, the tail swings to the other side as a counterweight; the slam at 22, two haunch pushes for waves 2 / 3

clips.name: stomp3_fl
clips.note: three front stomps A / B / A (the left fore lifts 4-18 and slams at 22, the right lifts 29-40 and slams at 45, the left again 52-63 / 68); the body rolls away from each lifted paw and the head turns to it; a shiver after every slam

clips.name: stomp3_fr
clips.note: mirror of stomp3_fl: three front stomps A / B / A (the left fore lifts 4-18 and slams at 22, the right lifts 29-40 and slams at 45, the left again 52-63 / 68); the body rolls away from each lifted paw and the head turns to it; a shiver after every slam

clips.name: feint
clips.note: the feint: sway to its right 0-11 (roll 8, head 10 right), sway back past the centre to the left 11-17, the heave (root +0.14) and the drop to root -0.42 at 22 (burst, the plates bristling), a shudder 22-32, recover

clips.name: tail_whip_l
clips.note: the tail raised high (the tell) 0-10 with the body coiled to its left, cocked to its right 14-20, dropped flat 20-23, the sweep 23-31 (the anchor +115 by the exported schedule, the fores stepping round twice, the hinds swinging round), the follow-through overshoot 31-35, settled 42, the tail back to its arc by 62

clips.name: tail_whip_r
clips.note: mirror of tail_whip_l: the tail raised high (the tell) 0-10 with the body coiled to its left, cocked to its right 14-20, dropped flat 20-23, the sweep 23-31 (the anchor +115 by the exported schedule, the fores stepping round twice, the hinds swinging round), the follow-through overshoot 31-35, settled 42, the tail back to its arc by 62

clips.name: tail_slam
clips.note: the tail rises high over the rump 0-12 (a near straight pole, the tip ~12 b up, the body leaning onto the fores), held 12-48 with the tip quivering, slammed 48-52 straight back along the floor (impact 52), a bounce, the spikes 54, dragged 30 degrees aside and lifted 58-70, settled by 90

clips.name: burrow_dive
clips.note: the snarl (head up, jaw 40), the head to the floor, the dive (nose-down 48 about the chest, root -3.6, a 16 degree twist, the hinds pushing), the rear and the tail slide under (root -11, the tail tucked after it); everything is under the floor by played 39 and hidden at the hand-over (40, state burrowed)

clips.name: burrow_travel
clips.note: underground: root -9, every part at scale 0 (hidden 0-19); tick 0 also records the burrowed state (the hand-over of burrow_dive)

clips.name: burrow_breach
clips.note: a surfacing: hidden to 7; at 8 the head and chest burst up nose-first (pitch +50, root -7.4 -> -2.4, jaw 44), hang 14-18, fall back under by 29, hidden 30-35

clips.name: burrow_emerge
clips.note: hidden to 23 (the module shows the dust and the burst at 8); from 24 the body rises nose-first through the floor (root -5.2 -> 0, pitch +34 -> 0), the fores claw out and plant at 30 / 31, the hinds climb out by 38 (out), the shake 40-50 (roll +-5, 4 t), the fores step back, settle

clips.name: landslide
clips.note: the tell 0-60 (head low, a growl, the right fore lifted 20-40 and the right hind 36-56); the crouch 60-72 and wave 1 at 76 (both fores); one fore per wave lifted from the previous wave to its slam (right 104, left 132, right 156, left 186); the gather 186-198, the big rear-up to 212 (pelvis +60, fores high, roaring), the hang to 236, the body slam at 240 (wave 6, plates flared), the heavy settle

clips.name: absorb
clips.note: the head pressed low to the floor with the rump and the plate crown up (flare +18) 0-12, the fores stepping wide; the hold 12-58 with a 20-t heave; push up 58-68; the left fore lifts and stamps at 76, the right at 100; settle

clips.name: absorb_p3
clips.note: it stands tall 0-20 (the front up, the head lifted to the orb over its back, the plates flared +15), the hold 20-58 with the chest heaving, a dip 58-63 and the gather at 60-66 (head up, jaw 30, plates +24), held for the roar the module plays next

clips.name: p3_sink
clips.note: crouch 0-8, the sink 8-32 (root -4.2, nose-down 25, rocking +-4), under 32-50 (everything below the floor by played 39); from played 40 the body is hidden, the root is offset forward 4.75 b so the tail root lies under the anchor (Rig decision change 1), the pillar rises straight out of the floor 62-71 (played 50-58: pillar) and settles

clips.name: tail_pillar
clips.note: the tail-only pillar on the anchor (body hidden, root offset): the column straight, the crown swaying +-6 (pitch, yaw, roll; 3 t lag up the chain); pulse at 0 / 40 (module fx)

clips.name: tail_pillar_strike
clips.note: a strike cue: the crown cocks back 0-6 and nods 30 degrees forward at 10 (strike), back by 24; the column stays on the anchor

clips.name: tail_pillar_sink
clips.note: the pillar drops straight down into the floor (ease in), under by 17, gone (hidden) at 18 (state burrowed)

clips.name: tail_cast
clips.note: the scorpion raise 0-12 (the column vertical over the rump, the leafy crown curled forward over the shoulders), the charge 12-22 (coiling tighter, quivering), fire at 24 (a recoil and snap), hold, lowered to the rest arc by 40

clips.name: death
clips.note: stagger 0-14 (rearing back, the head jerks up, jaw open); the fores buckle and slide out, the chest drops, the chin hits the floor at 34; the hinds fold, the belly on the floor by 52; the slump onto its right flank 52-64 with the tail falling flat at 66; the head lifts weakly at 80-82 and falls at 92; still from 96
